Class NitriteFilterBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.query.NitriteFilterBuilder
@Internal public final class NitriteFilterBuilder extends Object
Builder for Nitrite Filters from JSON-like structures.

Supports association path resolution for ONE_TO_MANY and MANY_TO_MANY relationships. Association names are matched using the associated entity's class name, which correctly handles both regular and irregular plural forms (for example, books → book, cities → city).

Since:
5.2.0
